name: Catalina
source: Catalina loves photography, she’s obsessed with remembering all the good things in life. She lives for documenting obscure, long forgotten, or untouched places. She’s motivated to capture the Carnival of Curiosities and share it with the world - a glimpse into the mystique of the rare carnival.
